meta.title: Snake
meta.description: The Nokia classic: eat, grow and don't bite your own tail.

modes.label: Game mode
modes.classicHint: Walls are deadly. Pick a level: the higher it is, the faster you go and the more you score.
modes.noWallsHint: Go through the edges. Speed goes up every 5 bites.

screens.controls: Use the D-pad, swipe on the board or the arrow keys.
